app.title: Schichtwechsel
app.tagline: Competition and workforce in drugstore retail
app.footer: Independent portfolio project. Job data: Bundesagentur für Arbeit. The HR data is synthetic and describes a fictional company.
app.data_down: The data could not be loaded ({error}). Please try again later.

common.source_ba: Source: job postings from the Bundesagentur für Arbeit, own analysis.

radar.title: Who is hiring where?
radar.intro: Open postings of the seven large drugstore and grocery retailers, daily from the job search of the Bundesagentur für Arbeit.
radar.map_help: Open postings of all seven retailers per 100,000 inhabitants. 100 = national average; blue below, amber above.
radar.per_store_help: Adjusted for size with the companies' store counts. Müller hires store staff through its own career site.
radar.minijob_help: Share of sales postings that offer a minijob.
radar.no_location: {n} postings without a location (mostly Kaufland apprenticeships) are not in the map.

offers.title: What do retailers offer?
offers.intro: Fields from the posting texts, extracted with Claude and checked against a hand-labelled sample (90 to 100% accuracy on most fields).
offers.benefits_help: Share of analysed postings that name the benefit.
offers.pay_help: Share of postings with an amount; most of the rest refer to the collective agreement.
offers.median_help: Median of stated hourly wages. From ten postings.
offers.coverage: Analysed: {n} posting texts. For the large retailers this is a sample of the newest postings.

workforce.title: Our own workforce
workforce.intro: A fictional chain with 300 stores. Exits depend, among other things, on the real competitor pressure in the region. Aggregates only; groups under five people are hidden.
workforce.outlook_help: Sum of the current staff's risk of leaving within three months.
workforce.drivers_title: What drives the risk of leaving
workforce.drivers_help: Mean contribution to the risk (SHAP). Age is not a model input.
workforce.ttf_help: Dot: median. Line: to the day by which four in five openings are filled (P80).
workforce.turnover_help: Share of employees leaving voluntarily in the month.

assistant.title: Ask the data
assistant.intro: The analyst queries the data with SQL. Every figure in an answer is checked against the query results. Individuals cannot be queried.
assistant.placeholder: Ask a question, for example about hiring pressure in Bavaria
ex: Where is pressure on store staff highest, and how long does filling an opening take there?
Which benefits does Rossmann mention more often than dm?
How many voluntary leavers do we expect in the next three months, and in which contract type?
How many postings does Lidl have open in Berlin?
assistant.ungrounded: The figures could not all be backed by the queries.
assistant.locked: The analyst uses a paid language model, so it is protected by an access code.
assistant.limit: The daily limit for questions is reached. Try again tomorrow.
